offering_description.value: Provides cashless payment hardware, software and managed services for unattended self-service retail such as vending machines, micro markets, kiosks and amusement. Sells to vending operators, convenience service companies and similar merchants, combining card readers, a cloud-based software platform and payment processing.

primary_products.value: card readers and payment terminals; micro market kiosks; point-of-sale hardware

primary_services.value: payment processing; cloud-based inventory and route management software; consumer engagement and loyalty tools; ERP and operations software

customer_segment.value: B2B: vending and micro market operators, convenience services, food service, amusement and laundry businesses

end_markets.value: unattended retail; vending; micro markets; food service; amusement and entertainment

revenue_model.value: subscription: recurring software and device service subscription fees; transaction or usage fees: payment processing fees on card transactions; product sales: card readers, kiosks and POS equipment
revenue_model.category: subscription; transaction or usage fees; product sales

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: cloud software platform for operators of self-service retail; financial intermediary: payment processing between consumers, operators and card networks; brand owner: designs payment devices made by contract manufacturers, sold to operators
value_chain_position.category: software / platform; financial intermediary; brand owner

geography_served.value: North America: United States primarily, with Canada and Europe also served

specialization.value: related lines: payments, hardware, and software for self-service commerce

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales team selling to vending operators and enterprise accounts; partners / resellers: channel partners and resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: payment processing subject to PCI DSS, card network rules and money transmission and consumer protection rules

notes: Cantaloupe was reported to be acquired by 365 Retail Markets in 2025; details of current status are uncertain.
